findings.failure_path: A transiently slow baseline enlarges both later bounds without limit. For example, a 12-second baseline followed by 6-second startup and a regressed 10-second probe passes the timeout case: 16 <= 12 + 7. Exit code 124 and all classification assertions can still match. The baseline's exit-code check does not prevent this false green.
findings.smallest_fix: Record probe start time inside each tested invocation and bound that invocation's probe duration, rather than subtracting startup measured by a separate invocation.

findings.failure_path: The assertion does not establish that the probe delay was charged. If remaining budget is calculated before the probe, 6 seconds of startup produces a formal timeout of 24; omitting the subsequent 2-second probe charge still satisfies 1 <= formal_timeout < 30. M3, which removes all elapsed-time charging, does not exercise this failure.
findings.smallest_fix: Assert that the formal timeout includes deduction of the measured probe delay as well as startup, and verify a mutation that calculates remaining budget before the probe.
